title: tenant-api chart values — top-level keys + writeBack
description: Catches a misspelled key at `helm template` / `helm install` instead of letting it be silently ignored (#1594). Constrains the TOP-LEVEL key set and the whole writeBack block (additionalProperties:false); every other block is left open. Semantic checks stay in the templates' {{ fail }} guards on purpose, because their messages explain WHY a value is refused: writeBack.mode="" (unset) and every cross-field requirement of the PR modes are refused by tenant-api.writeBackGuard in templates/_helpers.tpl, so the schema admits "" and does not type directAcknowledgeNotDelivered (the guard accepts only the boolean true, and says so). Only the KEY sets and writeBack.mode's values are constrained; the other leaves are deliberately untyped (a numeric GitLab project id, an unquoted numeric branch name are legal and the templates handle them).

global.description: Helm's own key, present when this chart is used as a subchart. Not read by any template.

replicaCount.description: MUST stay 1 (ADR-023 single writer) — enforced by the fail guard in templates/deployment.yaml, not here.

mode.description: tenant-api --write-mode. "" is the shipped default and means unset: the render fails with the writeBack guard's explanation. The non-empty values are the binary's legal --write-mode values minus the `pr` alias of pr-github, which the chart does not wire (its forge flags are keyed on pr-github / pr-gitlab). Pinned to the binary by components/tenant-api/cmd/server/chart_schema_test.go.

directAcknowledgeNotDelivered.description: Only the boolean true acknowledges direct mode; the writeBack guard refuses anything else, including the string "true".

project.description: group/project path or numeric project id — a number is legal, the template renders it as an integer.
